profile.name: 光谱仪校准EEPROM
profile.description: 这是集成在 Wasatch Photonics 光谱仪中的非易失性存储器，用于保存序列号、波长校准、探测器感兴趣区域、激光功率与探测器 TEC 校准、拉曼强度校准以及多波长配置等出厂参数。实验室中这些数据用于维持光谱仪的标定一致性、设备识别和测量配置，常见于拉曼及其他光谱测量系统。
profile.description_en: This is a non-volatile memory component integrated into Wasatch Photonics spectrometers, used to store factory parameters such as serial number, wavelength calibration, detector ROI, laser power and detector TEC calibration, Raman intensity calibration, and multi-wavelength configuration. In laboratory use, this stored data supports instrument identification, calibration consistency, and measurement setup for Raman and other spectroscopy systems.

registry.name: Open Standard EEPROM
registry.description: Eeprom驱动，支持init fields/is editable/update editable/parse/read eeprom等46个操作。
